title: Cockpit 3.0 Video Overlays
description: Zone Overlays, Zone Proximity Warnings, Live Annotation and Go to Location from Video on the Cockpit 3.0 live video.
overview: The Video overlays panel adds four capabilities to the Cockpit 3.0 live video: Zone Overlays, Zone Proximity Warnings, Live Annotation and Go to Location from Video. The panel sits at the bottom-right of the video.
when_to_use: Flying near No-Fly Zones (NFZs) or close to the Geofence.
Several people are monitoring the same drone and need to point things out.
when_not_to_use: Marks must stay on the map after the operation: use Annotations instead.
availability: Behind a feature flag. Contact the FlytBase team to enable it for your organization.
prerequisites: The zones are synced to the drone.
The payload camera feed is streaming.
dependencies: Go to Location from Video depends on the Fast telemetry link under **Drone settings > Telemetry**.
navigation: **Video overlays** at the bottom-right of the live video.

controls_and_indicators.name: **Video overlays**
controls_and_indicators.description: Button at the bottom-right of the video that opens the overlay panel.

controls_and_indicators.name: **Zone overlays**
controls_and_indicators.description: Toggle that shows NFZs and the Geofence on the video.

controls_and_indicators.name: **Zone proximity warnings**
controls_and_indicators.description: Toggle for the NFZ warnings on the video.

controls_and_indicators.name: **Live annotations**
controls_and_indicators.description: Toggle that shows or hides marks from other people.

controls_and_indicators.name: **Go to location**
controls_and_indicators.description: Right-click menu option that opens the Go to Location panel.

steps.text: **Click** **Video overlays**. The panel opens.
**Turn on** **Zone overlays**. Cockpit draws NFZs in red and the Geofence in green.
**Click** the eye icon next to **NFZs**. Cockpit hides the NFZs.
**Click** the eye icon next to **Geofence**. Cockpit hides the Geofence.
**Watch** the zones on the live video as the camera moves.
**Turn on** **Zone proximity warnings** in **Video overlays**.
**Check** the label at the top of the video. The arrow points to the zone and the label shows the distance.
**Look** at the map. The matching zone blinks while the warning shows.
**Turn on** **Live annotations** in **Video overlays**.
**Click** the **Live annotation** button (pen icon). The toolbar opens.
**Draw** with **Freehand** on the video. Everyone on the drone sees the line.
**Drag** with **Direction** to draw an arrow.
**Click** **Place a symbol** and choose a symbol.
**Click** the spot on the video where the symbol goes.
**Pick** an ink color for the next mark.
**Click** **Remove my marks for everyone**. A tick confirms the removal.
**Watch** the marks appear for every viewer and fade on their own.

procedures.task: send the drone to a point on the video

steps.text: **Right-click** the ground in the payload camera feed. The menu shows **Go to location**.
**Click** **Go to location**. The panel opens with **Latitude** and **Longitude** filled in.
**Click** **Launch**.
**Watch** the pin on the video. It stays fixed to the ground.
**Wait** for **Reached location** at the top of the video.

expected_behavior: A proximity warning starts 40 m from an NFZ.
Freehand lines fade after about 4 seconds.
Up to eight symbols stay on one camera at a time; the oldest is removed first.
operating_constraints: Proximity warnings cover NFZs only, not the Geofence.
The Go to Location point must be on the ground and within 5 km of the drone.

edge_cases.behavior: Cockpit shows that warnings are off instead of showing clear airspace.

system_messages.message: Only available on the payload camera.
system_messages.meaning: The feature does not work on the FPV or dock camera.
system_messages.action: Switch the video to the payload camera.

faqs.question: Why does no glow appear near the Geofence
faqs.answer: Warnings cover NFZs only. See Operating Constraints.

after_completion: Cockpit remembers each toggle the next time the panel opens.

glossary.definition: A No-Fly Zone synced to the drone.
